bug_summary: Route()にnil関数を渡すと空のサブルータが黙って登録され、Mount()にnilハンドラを渡すと後でnil pointerによりクラッシュする問題を修正し、明示的にpanicして早期検知するよう変更
pr_title: Allow nil Route callback and simplify Mount registration
pr_description: Route no longer panics when given a nil configuration callback; it just skips invoking it and mounts an empty subrouter. Mount drops its own nil-handler panic as well, keeping validation centered on pattern conflicts rather than argument presence.
